symptom.zh: 車主說：「早上第一次發動，引擎那邊會『咔咔咔』響兩三秒，然後就安靜了。最近好像越來越久。」
symptom.en: The owner says: "First start in the morning there is a rattle from the engine for two or three seconds, then it goes quiet. It seems to be lasting longer lately."

prompt.zh: 聲音只在什麼時候出現，最有診斷價值？
prompt.en: When does the noise appear? Which answer tells you the most?

options.en: The first few seconds after a cold start

explain.zh: 鏈條張緊器靠機油壓力撐住鏈條。冷車剛發動時油壓還沒建立，鬆掉的鏈條就會拍打導軌，等油壓上來就安靜了。
explain.en: The chain tensioner is held out by oil pressure. Before pressure builds on a cold start a slack chain slaps the guides; once it rises the noise stops.

prompt.zh: 接上診斷電腦，哪一組故障碼最支持你的懷疑？
prompt.en: With a scan tool connected, which codes best support your suspicion?

options.zh: 曲軸與凸輪軸位置不一致（P0016 / P0017）

explain.zh: 鏈條拉長或跳齒，凸輪軸和曲軸的相對位置就會跑掉，引擎電腦會記下「位置不一致」。
explain.en: A stretched or jumped chain shifts the cam relative to the crank, and the engine computer logs a correlation fault.

prompt.zh: 最可能的原因？
prompt.en: Most likely cause?

options.zh: 正時鏈導軌磨損、鏈條拉長
options.en: Worn timing-chain guides and a stretched chain

explain.zh: N20 早期的塑膠導軌會老化碎裂，症狀就是冷車咔咔聲。洩壓閥鬆動多半是怠速、輕油門時在渦輪附近響，不限冷車。
explain.en: Early N20 plastic guides degrade and break, and the symptom is a cold-start rattle. A loose wastegate rattles near the turbo at idle or light throttle, warm or cold.

replaceNote.zh: 鏈條、導軌、張緊器一起換，而且要用正時鎖定工具固定凸輪軸與曲軸再拆。N20 的正時鏈在引擎後方、靠變速箱側，所以要先拆變速箱（這就是為什麼它是大工程）。也要檢查油底殼與機油吸油網有沒有導軌碎片。
replaceNote.en: Replace chain, guides and tensioner together, with the timing tools locking the cams and crank. On the N20 the chain is at the back of the engine on the gearbox side, so the gearbox comes off first; that is why the job is big. Check the sump and pickup screen for guide fragments.

reassembleNote.zh: 裝回後手轉曲軸兩圈，確認正時記號對齊再發動。
reassembleNote.en: After reassembly turn the crank two full turns by hand and confirm the timing marks before starting.

title.en: Rough idle with a flashing engine light

symptom.zh: 車主說：「停紅燈時車子一直抖，剛剛引擎燈還在閃。」
symptom.en: The owner says: "It shakes at traffic lights, and the engine light was flashing just now."

prompt.zh: 引擎燈「閃爍」跟「恆亮」差在哪？
prompt.en: What does a flashing engine light mean compared with a steady one?

options.zh: 閃爍代表嚴重失火，未燃的油會讓觸媒過熱，要減速盡快處理
options.en: Flashing means a severe misfire; unburnt fuel can overheat the catalyst, so ease off and deal with it soon
Flashing is just a service reminder

explain.zh: 恆亮是「有問題，記下來了」；閃爍是「現在正在嚴重失火」，繼續猛踩可能燒壞觸媒。
explain.en: Steady means a fault is stored; flashing means a severe misfire is happening now and hard driving can destroy the catalyst.

prompt.zh: 故障碼是第 3 缸失火（P0303）。最便宜、最快的確認方法？
prompt.en: The code is cylinder 3 misfire (P0303). Cheapest, quickest confirmation?

options.zh: 把第 3 缸考爾和第 1 缸對調，看故障碼是否變成 P0301
options.en: Swap coil 3 with coil 1 and see if the code becomes P0301

explain.zh: 故障跟著考爾跑到第 1 缸，就是考爾壞；留在第 3 缸，再查火星塞、噴油嘴。
explain.en: If the fault follows the coil to cylinder 1, the coil is bad; if it stays on 3, check the plug and injector next.

prompt.zh: 對調後故障碼變成 P0301。原因是？
prompt.en: After the swap the code is now P0301. The cause?

options.zh: 第 3 缸原本那顆考爾壞了
options.en: The coil that was on cylinder 3 is faulty

explain.zh: 故障跟著考爾走，問題就在考爾本身。順便看火星塞，間隙太大的火星塞會拖垮考爾。
explain.en: The fault followed the coil, so the coil is to blame. Check the plugs too: worn plugs with a wide gap overload coils.

replaceNote.zh: 模擬器把四顆考爾當成一組；實車只換壞的那顆。看橡膠套有沒有油：有油代表氣門室蓋墊片漏油。
replaceNote.en: The simulator treats the four coils as one set; on the car you replace only the bad one. Check the boot for oil: oil means a leaking valve-cover gasket.

reassembleNote.zh: 插頭插到聽到「喀」；清除故障碼後試車。
reassembleNote.en: Push the connector home until it clicks; clear the codes and road test.

title.zh: 水溫警告、暖氣忽冷忽熱
title.en: Overheat warning and an erratic heater

symptom.zh: 車主說：「儀表跳出引擎過熱的黃燈，暖氣一下熱一下冷。皮帶我看過，好好的。」
symptom.en: The owner says: "A yellow engine-overheat warning came on and the heater goes hot and cold. I checked the belt, it's fine."

prompt.zh: 看到水溫過高警告，第一件事？
prompt.en: First thing to do when the overheat warning appears?

options.zh: 安全停車熄火，等冷卻，不要開副水箱蓋
options.en: Stop safely, switch off, let it cool, and do not open the expansion tank
Open the cap at once and add water

options.zh: 踩油門讓水泵轉快一點
options.en: Rev it to spin the pump faster

explain.zh: 熱的冷卻系統有壓力，開蓋會噴出滾燙液體。N20 水泵是電子的，踩油門也不會讓它轉快。
explain.en: A hot system is pressurised and will spray scalding coolant. The N20 pump is electric, so revving does not speed it up.

prompt.zh: 車主說「皮帶好好的」，為什麼這對 N20 不能排除水泵？
prompt.en: The owner says the belt is fine. Why does that not clear the pump on an N20?

options.zh: N20 是電子水泵，不靠皮帶驅動
options.en: The N20 pump is electric, not belt driven
The pump is in the gearbox

explain.zh: 傳統引擎水泵掛在皮帶上；N20 用電子水泵，皮帶正常它照樣會壞。
explain.en: On many engines the pump is on the belt; the N20 uses an electric pump that can fail with a perfect belt.

prompt.zh: 最可能的原因？
prompt.en: Most likely cause?

explain.zh: 水溫忽高忽低、暖氣不穩定，是 N20 電子水泵故障的典型症狀，常和節溫器一起換。
explain.en: Fluctuating temperature and an erratic heater are classic N20 electric-pump symptoms; the thermostat is usually replaced at the same time.

replaceNote.zh: 通常節溫器一起換。冷卻液要用抽真空加注或診斷電腦跑排氣程序，不然系統裡有空氣會再過熱。
replaceNote.en: The thermostat is usually done at the same time. Fill with a vacuum filler or run the bleed routine from a diagnostic tool, or trapped air causes more overheating.

reassembleNote.zh: 裝回後檢查所有水管束環，發動跑到正常溫度，確認沒有漏水。
reassembleNote.en: Check every hose clamp, run it to temperature and confirm there are no leaks.

symptom.zh: 車主說：「開冷氣外循環時聞到燒焦的機油味，儀表偶爾提醒機油太少。」
symptom.en: The owner says: "With the A/C on fresh air I smell burning oil, and now and then it warns the oil is low."

prompt.zh: 燒機油味最常見的來源？
prompt.en: Most common source of a burning-oil smell?

options.zh: 漏出的機油滴到排氣管或渦輪上
options.en: Leaking oil dripping onto the exhaust or turbo

explain.zh: 機油滴到幾百度的排氣上會冒煙，被外循環吸進車內。這也有火災風險。
explain.en: Oil on an exhaust at several hundred degrees smokes and is pulled in through the fresh-air intake. It is also a fire risk.

prompt.zh: N20 有兩個常見漏油點：機濾座墊片和氣門室蓋。怎麼分？
prompt.en: The N20 has two classic leaks: the oil-filter-housing gasket and the valve cover. How do you tell them apart?

options.zh: 清乾淨後找油漬「最高點」在哪個零件周圍
options.en: Clean it, then find the highest point of the oil trail and which part it is around

explain.zh: 機油往下流，所以要找最上面的濕點。兩個漏油點症狀很像，位置不同。
explain.en: Oil runs downhill, so find the topmost wet spot. The two leaks look alike but sit in different places.

prompt.zh: 油漬最高點在機油濾芯座下緣，皮帶上也有油。原因？
prompt.en: The top of the oil trail is at the base of the oil filter housing, and the belt is oily. The cause?

options.zh: 機油濾芯座墊片老化漏油

explain.zh: 機濾座墊片是橡膠，受熱老化後漏油，油會流到下方皮帶上。
explain.en: The housing gasket is rubber; it hardens with heat and leaks onto the belt below.

replaceNote.zh: 換墊片時順便看皮帶：泡過油的皮帶要一起換。
replaceNote.en: While the gasket is done, check the belt: an oil-soaked belt must be replaced too.

reassembleNote.zh: 螺絲扭力待查證，照原廠；補機油到正常油位後發動檢查。
reassembleNote.en: Bolt torque unverified (use BMW data); top up the oil and check for leaks with the engine running.

symptom.zh: 車主說：「儀表叫我換來令片很久了，這兩天踩煞車左前輪會有『嘰——』的金屬摩擦聲。」
symptom.en: The owner says: "The dash has told me to change pads for ages, and now the left front makes a metal-on-metal grind when I brake."

prompt.zh: 金屬摩擦聲代表什麼？
prompt.en: What does the grinding mean?

options.zh: 來令片磨到底板，鐵在磨碟盤
options.en: The pad is down to the backing plate, steel on the rotor

options.zh: 剛換新片的正常磨合聲

explain.zh: 摩擦材料用完了，鐵背板直接磨碟盤，碟盤也會被刮傷。
explain.en: The friction material is gone and the steel backing plate is scoring the rotor.

prompt.zh: BMW 怎麼知道該換來令片？
prompt.en: How does BMW know the pads are due?

options.zh: 來令片磨損感知器，再由 CBS 估算剩餘里程
options.en: Pad wear sensors, with CBS estimating the remaining distance

explain.zh: 感知線埋在來令片裡，磨到時迴路斷開，CBS 就提醒。所以磨斷過的感知器要換新。
explain.en: A sensor wire is buried in the pad; when worn through the circuit breaks and CBS warns. A worn-through sensor must be replaced.

prompt.zh: 這次要換什麼？
prompt.en: What needs replacing this time?

options.zh: 來令片和碟盤（碟盤已被刮傷）
options.en: Pads and rotor (the rotor is scored)

explain.zh: 鐵磨鐵之後碟盤通常已經刮出溝或低於最小厚度，要一起換。
explain.en: After metal-on-metal the rotor is usually grooved or under minimum thickness, so it goes too.

replaceNote.zh: 一軸一起換（左右兩邊），磨損感知器換新。碟盤最小厚度刻在碟盤上。
replaceNote.en: Always do both sides of the axle and fit a new wear sensor. The minimum rotor thickness is stamped on the rotor.

reassembleNote.zh: 裝回後先踩幾下煞車到踏板變硬再開車，然後照程序磨合。
reassembleNote.en: Pump the pedal firm before driving, then bed the pads in.

title.en: Will not start in the morning

symptom.zh: 車主說：「按啟動鈕，儀表跳一堆警告燈、起動馬達轉得很慢，時鐘也跑掉了。電瓶用了五年。」
symptom.en: The owner says: "When I press start the dash lights up with warnings, the starter turns slowly and the clock has reset. The battery is five years old."

prompt.zh: 「起動馬達轉很慢、一堆警告燈、時鐘重設」最指向？
prompt.en: "Slow cranking, lots of warning lights, clock reset" points most to…

explain.zh: 起動馬達壞通常是儀表正常、只聽到「喀」一聲；電瓶沒力時，所有電子模組都會一起抗議。
explain.en: A dead starter usually means a normal dash and a single click; a weak battery makes every module complain at once.

prompt.zh: BMW 換新電瓶後還要做什麼？
prompt.en: What else must be done after fitting a new battery on a BMW?

options.en: Register the battery with a diagnostic tool

explain.zh: IBS 會依電瓶老化調整充電；註冊讓它重新從新電瓶開始學，否則新電瓶會被過度充電、提早老化。
explain.en: The IBS adapts charging to the aging battery; registering resets it for the new one, otherwise the new battery is overcharged and ages early.

prompt.zh: 最可能的原因？
prompt.en: Most likely cause?

explain.zh: 五年、症狀典型，先換電瓶；換完還是一樣，才往起動馬達或線路查。
explain.en: Five years old and textbook symptoms: battery first; if nothing changes, then the starter or wiring.

replaceNote.zh: 先拆負極再拆正極；同類型、同容量。換完一定要註冊。
replaceNote.en: Negative off first, then positive; same type and capacity. Register it afterwards.

reassembleNote.zh: 先接正極再接負極；車窗可能要重新學習一鍵升降（依車型）。
reassembleNote.en: Positive on first, then negative; the windows may need their one-touch function relearned (model dependent).

symptom.zh: 車主說：「上坡在五檔踩油門，轉速一下衝上去，車速卻沒跟上，有時還有燒焦味。」
symptom.en: The owner says: "Uphill in fifth, I press the throttle and the revs flare but the speed doesn't follow, sometimes with a burning smell."

prompt.zh: 要確認離合器打滑，最簡單的測試？
prompt.en: Simplest test to confirm a slipping clutch?

options.zh: 高檔低轉速時全油門，看轉速是否竄升而車速不跟
options.en: Full throttle at low revs in a high gear: do revs rise without speed?

explain.zh: 高檔低轉扭力負荷最大，打滑最容易出現。空檔沒有負荷，看不出來。
explain.en: High gear at low revs puts the most torque through the clutch, so slip shows; neutral has no load.

prompt.zh: 為什麼「渦輪漏氣」不太符合這個症狀？
prompt.en: Why does a boost leak not fit these symptoms?

options.zh: 渦輪漏氣是「沒力」，轉速和車速會一起慢慢上，不會轉速亂衝
options.en: A boost leak means weak power; revs and speed rise slowly together, the revs do not flare

explain.zh: 關鍵是「轉速和車速脫鉤」：引擎有在出力，但力量沒傳到變速箱。
explain.en: The key is revs and road speed decoupling: the engine is making power but it is not reaching the gearbox.

prompt.zh: 最可能的原因？
prompt.en: Most likely cause?

explain.zh: 離合器片的摩擦材料磨薄，壓板夾不住，就會打滑。
explain.en: The disc lining is thin and the pressure plate can no longer clamp it.

replaceNote.zh: 離合器片和壓板一起換，分離軸承也建議換。雙質量飛輪要檢查：有異音或晃動過大也要換。
replaceNote.en: Replace disc and pressure plate together, and the release bearing is recommended. Inspect the dual-mass flywheel: replace it if noisy or with excessive play.

reassembleNote.zh: 用離合器校正棒對正離合器片，壓板螺絲對角分段鎖。
reassembleNote.en: Centre the disc with the alignment tool and tighten the pressure-plate bolts in stages, crosswise.
